name: Gweike G6 Split 70W
tagline: 70W Split cabinet fiber marker with room for rotary and fixtures
tldr: Gweike G6 Split 70W is the 70W SKU on the Gweike gweike g6 split line. Gweike G6 Split is a larger fiber marking platform with separate laser source cabinet: common format for small production. Verify optical power on the listing: do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: Maximum fiber marking speed and depth in the line

priceRange.note: 70W optical module: verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled logo on stainless steel plate

pros: Faster deep work than the 50W: about 2–6 min vs 3–8 min for a filled 10 × 10 cm logo on stainless (our benchmark)
$1,300–1,400 less than the 100W with manual lift
cons: Close to the 100W in our filled-logo benchmark: the gain over the 50W shows mostly on deep jobs
Colour and lift options move the price by up to $600 for the same power ($4,899 to $5,499)
Q-switched source, no MOPA: no controlled colour marking

faq.question: Why choose a 70W G6 Split rather than the 50W?
faq.answer: For deep engraving and cut-outs. In our benchmark, a filled 10 × 10 cm logo on stainless takes about 2–6 minutes on the 70W, against 3–8 on the 50W. Surface marks look the same at both powers; the 70W shortens the jobs that need many passes, such as deep logos, embossing and thin-sheet parts.

faq.question: How much does the G6 Split 70W cost?
faq.answer: On Gweike's US store in October 2026: $4,899–4,999 with manual lift, $4,999–5,099 with electric lift and $5,399–5,499 with electric lift and autofocus, depending on the colour. That is about $1,000 more than the 50W and $1,300–1,400 less than the 100W in similar configurations.

faq.question: 70W or 100W G6 Split for a production shop?
faq.answer: In our benchmark the two are close on a filled logo (about 2–6 minutes vs 2–5). The 100W starts at $6,299 against $4,899 for the 70W. Choose the 100W only if deep engraving or cut-outs run most of the day; otherwise the 70W covers most production work for less.

standoutFeatures.title: Built for repeated deep passes
standoutFeatures.body: 70W of average power from a Raycus Q-switched source. Deep logos, embossing and thin-metal cut-outs need fewer passes than on the 50W, which is where the extra cost pays back.

standoutFeatures.title: Below the 100W price line
standoutFeatures.body: From $4,899 with manual lift, $1,400 less than the 100W, for most of its benefit on everyday filled-logo jobs according to our benchmark.

beginnerNotes: This profile is the 70W SKU on Gweike G6 Split. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Push speed only after depth tests on your metal alloy. Cooling and lens cleanliness matter more at this power level.
primaryUse: High-power fiber for metal-focused shops needing line-top throughput

editorialDepth.advantages: Gweike G6 Split 70W fits shops that mark stainless, aluminum, and tools daily without a CO₂ bay. A solid bench option for jewelry, tags, and small batches.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if wood, leather, or cast acrylic pay your bills. Deep metal cutting and large industrial panels often need more fiber headroom (100W) or a different machine class.
